result.summary: The page is broadly coherent, but several rendering problems stand out: the second 'Popular right now' card is missing its title/metadata block, a stray dark bar overlaps the bottom navigation icons, carousel text is hard-clipped without ellipsis, and favorite-button styling is inconsistent between cards.

issues.description: A solid dark horizontal bar sits across the bottom navigation bar, overlapping/obscuring the middle (search and bookmark/orders) icons. It looks like a stray drag handle, scroll indicator, or mis-sized element rendered on top of the tab bar.
issues.suggestion: Remove or reposition the overlapping element (e.g., the gesture/handle bar) so it does not cover tab icons; ensure the tab bar has its own layer above the scroll content and correct z-index/padding.

issues.description: The second card in 'Popular right now' (the pizza image with the −20% badge) has no restaurant name, rating, delivery time, or price row, unlike the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card above it. The card appears truncated/unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Render the full card content (name, rating, ETA, delivery fee, cuisine) for every list item, or add skeleton/loading placeholders while data is fetched.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the first popular card uses a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the second uses a dark/transparent circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button to a single variant (e.g., translucent dark scrim with white icon) across all cards for a consistent visual language.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third item's title is hard-clipped mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol') at the screen edge with no ellipsis, and the card itself is cut off, giving no clear affordance that the row scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with ellipsis, add consistent right-edge peek/padding, and consider a fade or partial card plus scroll indicator to signal horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: The category chip row is also cut off at the right edge, with a sliver of the next chip visible, which reads as a rendering glitch rather than a scrollable row.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent horizontal padding so the next chip is clearly partially visible, or add a gradient fade/arrow to communicate scrollability.

issues.description: Bottom navigation icons have no text labels, and the notification bell / heart buttons are icon-only, making purpose unclear for screen readers and low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Add visible labels under the tab icons and accessible names (aria-label/contentDescription) for all icon-only controls.

issues.description: Delivery-fee and time badges use differing shapes/placement across sections (pill inside image bottom-left in the carousel vs. top-left in the popular cards), reducing visual consistency.
issues.suggestion: Align badge position, padding, and corner radius across all card types.
